title: Fake clock, fake read

blocks.md:
## Do not wait on the real clock

`now()` should call `deps.clock()`. In tests, pass `{ clock: () => 1000 }`.

`load(deps)` should call `deps.read("log.txt")`. Fake `read` returns `"north"`.

Print `1000 north`.

choices.md: Needs the real disk every time
Controls the bytes without a real file

blocks.promptMd: > `report({ clock, read })` prints `clock() + " " + read("log.txt")`. Use 1000 and north.

hintLadder.md: Do not call Date.now() or fs in report — use deps.

description: Fake the clock and the disk so a test does not wait or write for real.
